plugins.name: revizto-project-intelligence
plugins.description: Live project intelligence over the Revizto MCP Server — a six-view Cowork dashboard plus the curated Revizto platform skills. Opens read-only every session, with a user-controlled toggle for approved writes. Discovers the installing user's own licences and projects at runtime; headline totals are exact, sampled detail is always labelled.
